architecture_source.name: VERUM — Master Project Context and Engineering Desicion.md

roles.name: Predictive Health
roles.responsibilities: Estimate health trends, degradation trajectory, risk of future abnormal behavior
roles.inputs: Time series, operating modes, physics residuals, asset history
roles.outputs: Health scores with uncertainty, forecasts, degradation flags
roles.restrictions: Do not assert remaining useful life without validation
roles.data_scope: future measured signal summaries; no invented health score or RUL

roles.name: Anomaly Detection
roles.responsibilities: Identify departures from operating-condition-aware baselines; separate regime changes from anomalies
roles.inputs: Sensors, timestamps, operating state, healthy-twin expectations
roles.outputs: Anomaly events, residuals, confidence, affected channels
roles.restrictions: Avoid using hidden fault labels at inference
roles.data_scope: observed quality plus masked reference-injection detection

roles.name: Topology & Dependency
roles.responsibilities: Represent tank/manifold/valve/pump/pipe connectivity, flow direction, active routing and propagation paths
roles.inputs: Asset graph, valve/pump state observations, operating schedules
roles.outputs: Candidate upstream/downstream assets, causal reachability, routing ambiguity
roles.restrictions: Commanded valve state ≠ confirmed actual state
roles.data_scope: declared graph/reference retrieval; contacts are not true valve position

roles.name: Historical & Asset Intelligence
roles.responsibilities: Retrieve maintenance, calibration, past failures, inspection records, equipment specifications and provenance
roles.inputs: CMMS-like records, asset registry, prior episodes
roles.outputs: Relevant evidence, known limitations, comparable historical patterns
roles.restrictions: Synthetic history must be labeled synthetic
roles.data_scope: source asset records and explicit missing history

roles.name: Diagnostic Reasoning
roles.responsibilities: Generate, compare and update single/multiple fault hypotheses; test physical consistency
roles.inputs: Outputs of agents 1–4, physics predictions, inspection evidence
roles.outputs: Ranked hypotheses with support/conflicts, uncertainty, alternative explanations
roles.data_scope: masked reduced-model injection labels, not field-confirmed diagnoses

roles.name: Inspection Planning
roles.responsibilities: Choose feasible next inspection/test based on diagnostic value, cost, time, accessibility and safety
roles.inputs: Hypotheses, available tests, expected observation models, constraints
roles.outputs: Recommended inspection, rationale, expected discrimination, alternatives
roles.restrictions: Do not recommend unsafe access or automatic intervention
roles.data_scope: catalog/constraint retrieval; no invented best-action or information gain

roles.name: Inspection Quality & Documentation
roles.responsibilities: Guide evidence capture, units, calibration, timestamps, completeness, chain of custody and reporting
roles.inputs: Inspection procedure, technician observations, instrument metadata
roles.data_scope: observed record quality plus separately audited inspection records

roles.name: Evidence Verification & Decision
roles.responsibilities: Check evidence provenance, consistency, contradictory results and decision readiness
roles.outputs: Updated assessment, recommendation, escalation/hold, auditable explanation
roles.data_scope: evidence admissibility without future numerical values or hidden truth
